source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps threefold self-identification and future glory.
key_decisions.before: So I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, as well as a sharer in the glory that is going to be revealed:
key_decisions.after: Therefore, I urge the elders among you, as a fellow elder, a witness of Christ's sufferings and a partner in the glory about to be revealed:
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: So I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, as well as a sharer in the glory that is going to be revealed:

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves shepherding, oversight and both motive contrasts.
key_decisions.before: shepherd the flock of God that is among you, exercising oversight, not under compulsion, but willingly, as God would have you; not for shameful gain, but eagerly;
key_decisions.after: Shepherd God's flock among you, exercising oversight not under compulsion but willingly, according to God; not for shameful gain but eagerly;
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: shepherd the flock of God that is among you, exercising oversight, not under compulsion, but willingly, as God would have you; not for shameful gain, but eagerly;

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps prohibition of domination and exemplary alternative.
key_decisions.before: not domineering over those in your charge, but being examples to the flock.
key_decisions.after: not lording it over those entrusted to you, but becoming examples to the flock.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: not domineering over those in your charge, but being examples to the flock.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains pastoral title, appearance and crown.
key_decisions.before: And when the chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.
key_decisions.after: And when the chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when the chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the unfading crown of glory.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps age relation, clothing image and quoted reversal.
key_decisions.before: Likewise, you who are younger, be subject to the elders. Clothe yourselves, all of you, with humility toward one another, for “God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.”
key_decisions.after: Likewise, younger people, submit to the elders. And all of you, clothe yourselves with humility toward one another, because “God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Likewise, you who are younger, be subject to the elders. Clothe yourselves, all of you, with humility toward one another, for “God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.”

key_decisions.rationale: Retains legal opponent, animal simile and violent threat.
key_decisions.before: Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
key_decisions.after: Be sober and alert. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps resistance, stability and global solidarity.
key_decisions.before: Resist him, firm in your trust, knowing that the same kinds of suffering are being experienced by your brotherhood throughout the world.
key_decisions.after: Resist him, firm in the faith, knowing that the same sufferings are being endured by your family of believers throughout the world.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Resist him, firm in your faith, knowing that the same kinds of suffering are being experienced by your brotherhood throughout the world.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains suffering duration, call and four divine actions.
key_decisions.before: And after you have suffered a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to his eternal glory in Christ, will himself restore, confirm, strengthen, and establish you.
key_decisions.after: After you have suffered a little while, the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, will himself restore, establish, strengthen and ground you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And after you have suffered a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to his eternal glory in Christ, will himself restore, confirm, strengthen, and establish you.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps messenger, personal assessment and two purposes.
key_decisions.before: By Silvanus, a faithful brother as I regard him, I have written briefly to you, exhorting and declaring that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.
key_decisions.after: Through Silvanus, whom I regard as a faithful brother, I have written to you briefly, encouraging you and testifying that this is God's true grace. Stand firm in it.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: By Silvanus, a faithful brother as I regard him, I have written briefly to you, exhorting and declaring that this is the true grace of God. Stand firm in it.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains feminine coded sender, Babylon and named Mark.
key_decisions.before: She who is in Babylon, who is likewise chosen, sends you greetings, and so does Mark, my son.
key_decisions.after: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you, and so does my son Mark.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: She who is in Babylon, who is likewise chosen, sends you greetings, and so does Mark, my son.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps embodied greeting and inclusive peace.
key_decisions.before: Greet one another with the kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
key_decisions.after: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Greet one another with the kiss of love. Peace to all of you who are in Christ.
